applies: a GavickPro Gavern (gk_*) quickstart: the same site module as the JA families, in the earliest position its layout renders. Gavern has no runtime colour variables: its compiled stylesheets read the slot once tokenized (a JoomlArt re-release), and the slot's own selector rules do the rest
specificity: Rules are prefixed :root×6 (0,6,0): above every template rule, below an element's own inline style.
genericNote: the slot writes no short token names (--bg, --accent…) here; everything reads --ds-c-*

discovered.page: outermost element painted the page colour (body is not)
discovered.heading: first section heading: 48px
discovered.button-primary: first filled, coloured call to action: rgb(201, 80, 74)
discovered.displayPhone: the same heading at 390 on the published release: 44.8px

keepNote: kept: the home hero (.acm-hero). Below 768 px its photo (.image-map, opacity 0.8) lies behind the heading, which the template paints white; a worn system painted its own text there (on the phone MotherDuck 2.79:1, Toggl Track 3.24:1, Apple 3.98:1; re-measure 12/10/2026). The band keeps the template's look at every width: its #161616 page ground (keepGround) and #828282 text (keepColors); the heading keeps the template's own white
readyNote: measured 11/10/2026 on quickstart/gavick-gk-compact/j6 1.0.0 with its stylesheets tokenized as 1.0.1 ships them (tasks/evidence/ds-contracts-gk-2026-10-11): 12/12, controls 0 differences, no text made less readable than the template's own under the four systems tried, 94%–100% of the page follows; the 1.0.1 build itself (restored from its zip) measured the same: 12/12 (its default look: 0 computed differences against 1.0.0; the pixels differ only where the home page's <marquee> moves); Gavern's widths and section paddings stay the template's, and the pricing columns let their nowrap plan titles wrap (breakWords) so a wider system face does not push the page sideways. The page colours follow only from 1.0.1 (~/tracy-bench-work/RELEASE-DS-GAVICK.sh, not yet uploaded); minVersion keeps 1.0.0 sites out (TEMPLATE_NEEDS_UPDATE). Re-measured 12/10/2026 with the unified probe (fix/ds-reverify-d) on the published 1.0.1: the phone hero heading lies on its photo there and took each system's text (2.79:1 under MotherDuck); the hero is now kept whole (keepNote), the logo kind dropped (an image link: no text to read), the primary-button role read in the pricing table outside the kept hero; then 12/12, controls 0 differences, 94%–100% of the page follows (tasks/evidence/ds-reverify-d-2026-10-12/gk-compact)
baseNote: painted on the default home page (discover.mjs), then T3 less/variables*.less (colours and faces); border and muted measured as the most painted line / grey text in css/*.css (64 line colours, 117 text colours seen)

bandsNote: drafted 2026-10-12 by scripts/bands.mjs off the released default page (/): each kept band that is not a picture wears the system's ground (src/bands.mjs), its words keep their colours; .acm-hero paints its own ground (#161616): the band repaints its root (13/10/2026) — drafted root:false with a path that named nothing, its hero stayed the template's under Stripe
sideNote: 13/10/2026: the ghost line under the hero (marquee h1, 160px, nowrap) is outline text: filled with the page's own colour (#161616) and stroked white at 15%, its word 'delivering' stroked in the accent. Its fill and stroke are literals, so under a light system it turned solid black on the light page; it now fills with the system's page colour and strokes with its text at 15% (the accent for the word). The display role is the hero heading (h1.heading, 72px; 44.8px at 390), not the marquee: the marquee keeps its own size
templateVarsNote: 15/10/2026 (look review v8): the 1.0.x stylesheet reads --ds-c-surface-warm in 41 rules, every one an accent fill (the primary button, active menu and page links, the social and pagination fills, the skill bars and their % badges, the section bars): baseTokens gave surface-warm the accent's own #c9504a, so the tokenizer took the red as surface-warm. Under a system that is a pale surface and the bars and badges went blank (white on white under Notion). The slot points it at the accent; a release made from corrected baseTokens no longer needs it. The about page’s stat cards (.acm-statistics.style-2) are a literal white with #333 words, the first one the accent with the page’s text: under Moxie the words read cream on white (1.16:1). The cards take the page’s surface and words, the first one the accent and its own words (followRules)
followNote: 13/10/2026: the 1.0.1 release reads its white headings and its grey body copy through the same role (var(--ds-c-fg, #fff) and var(--ds-c-fg, #828282)), so under a system both took the system's body grey and the headings lost their weight (Notion: section headings #6c6c6c, as grey as the text under them). Its headings, all white on the page, take the system's strongest ink (fg-2, textOrder) until a release tokenizes them as fg-2
